objective: Lemma S and proposition M by hand; the frozen exact census of harmonies (spans 2 to 10, four laws) and of every stitch and overlap of their orbits; the fresh-code referee.
status: Proved 2026-11-12: lemma S (any law: stitched harmonies repeat with period lcm(p, q), gcd(p, q) offsets kept or removed whole, no beat) and proposition M (not-all-equal: the mirror pairs offsets of antiperiodic harmonies iff p and q carry different powers of 2); exact census, refereed: not-all-equal harmonies have only even periods and the connected ones are antiperiodic to span 12; control laws make other periods; no stitch reads divisibility.
title: Stitching harmonies, and the harmonies the law makes
